properties.description:
Idea only; controls and switching modes during use remain TBD. User annotation 2, 2026-10-20.
Pixel mode: progressive scrolling with mouse-wheel control over slower/faster scrolling.
Item mode: the component consumer supplies pixel ranges; scroll between ranges with an animation whose speed is adjustable. Consumers may supply multiple overlapping ranges/range sets. The user can switch between overlapping alternatives but only one is active at a time; refine the exact range-selection contract.
Continuous mode: automatic scrolling with adjustable patterns, potentially composable with pixel and item modes. Support cycling or alternating up/down.
Do not treat this as accepted implementation design or start implementation.
properties.title: Composable pixel, item-range and continuous scrolling modes
